info.name: Luna Shopper — local (slot 0)
info.description:
Smoke and contract suite for the Luna Shopper backend running locally.

Run the folders in order: the run builds one identity and one zone and threads them through lists, lines and the catalog, then deletes what it made.

Point `baseUrl` at the gateway for your slot (slot 0 is http://localhost:3000) and `mailpitUrl` at Mailpit (slot 0 is http://localhost:8025).

Two assertions run against every single request: nothing may return 5xx, and nothing may take longer than 10s. A 5xx anywhere means a service behind the gateway is down or throwing, so check folder 00 first.

item.name: 09 · Assistant
item.description:
The assistant, both routes (plan 0039, and plan 0041 for the spoken one).

With no GEMINI_API_KEY these answer 501 not_configured, and that is a supported deployment rather than a broken one (plan 0026): the pod boots, the health probes pass, and this route says plainly it is not implemented here. So every test below accepts a 501 as a pass, and checks the shape of a real answer only when a key is configured.

The spoken route is multipart. Postman cannot carry a recording in a checked-in file, so pick any small audio file for the  part: nothing here decodes it, and with no key the request is refused before it would be read anyway.

request.description: The transcript is the conversation so far and `message` is what was just said. They are separate fields: the thing being answered must not also appear in the history of the question.

pm.test('SKIPPED: the free tier is rate limiting, which rule A5 says is ordinary', function () {
pm.test('it answered in words, with references it can back up', function () {

item.name: A spoken turn (pick an audio file)

request.description:
multipart/form-data: the recording as a file part, the transcript as a JSON string.

Do NOT set Content-Type by hand. Postman writes the boundary itself, and a hand written multipart/form-data header omits it and produces a body the server cannot split.

The cap is `ASSISTANT_AUDIO_MAX_BYTES` (2 MB by default) and it is enforced by the multipart interceptor, so a larger file is refused here before it reaches the broker.

formdata.description: Any small recording: webm, ogg, mp4 or wav.
The conversation so far, oldest first, as JSON.

item.name: A spoken turn with no recording is 400

request.description: The interceptor enforces the size of a part that is there; it does not insist one was sent. That is the controller, and it is a 400 rather than an empty buffer travelling to the service to be refused there.
